entries.head: get in
entries.zh: 钻进轿车、出租车、网约车；到达；进入

senses.zh: 钻进轿车、出租车、网约车
senses.en: to enter a car or other small vehicle

example.en: Get in — we're blocking the whole lane.
example.zh: 快上车，我们挡着整条道了。

senses.en: to arrive at a place

example.en: My flight gets in at ten tonight.

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

example.en: Get in — we're blocking the lane.

entries.l1_note: 小空间用 get in（轿车、网约车），大空间用 get on（地铁、公交、高铁、飞机）。中文都是“上车”，所以这里必错。

entries.head: get on
entries.zh: 上地铁、公交、高铁、飞机；穿上

senses.en: to board a bus, train, subway, or plane

example.en: Get on at Line 2 and transfer at People's Square.
example.zh: 坐 2 号线，在人民广场换乘。

senses.en: to put on clothing

example.en: Get your coat on — it's freezing outside.
example.zh: 把外套穿上，外面冷死了。

entries.l1_note: 中文“坐地铁”会让人漏掉上下车：get on the subway 是上车，take the subway 是乘坐。

entries.head: get off
entries.zh: 从交通工具上下来；下班离开；逃过处罚

senses.en: to leave a bus, train, or plane

example.en: Get off at the third stop and you'll see the mall.
example.zh: 第三站下车就能看到商场。

senses.en: to leave work at the end of the day

example.en: What time do you get off tonight?

senses.en: to avoid punishment

example.en: She got off with a warning because it was her first time.
example.zh: 因为是初犯，她只被警告就过去了。

entries.l1_note: 下车不是 get down（那是从高处下来）。get off work 才是下班。
collocations: get off at the next stop

entries.head: get around

senses.en: to travel from place to place in an area

example.en: The subway is the fastest way to get around Shanghai.

entries.l1_note: 出行、四处走动；get around to 是抽空做。

entries.head: pull over

senses.en: to drive to the side of the road and stop

example.en: The driver pulled over to check the address on his phone.
example.zh: 司机靠边停下，看手机上的地址。

entries.l1_note: “停车”有三个：pull over 靠边、park 停进车位、stop 停下。中文一个“停车”对应三个词。

entries.head: slow down

senses.en: to drive more slowly

example.en: Slow down — there's a speed camera up ahead.

senses.en: to do things less fast and with less pressure

example.en: You've been working nonstop. Slow down a bit.
example.zh: 你一直在连轴转，缓一缓吧。

entries.l1_note: “慢一点”对车说 slow down，对人说 take it easy；中文的“放慢”两种情况一个词就够，英语要分开。

entries.head: fill up

senses.en: to put gas in a car until the tank is full

example.en: Let's fill up before we get on the highway.

entries.l1_note: “加油”不是 add oil（那是中式英语）。加油是 fill up / get gas。
collocations: fill up at the gas station

entries.head: run out of

senses.en: to have no more of something

example.en: We ran out of gas on the way to the airport.
example.zh: 我们在去机场的路上把油用完了。

entries.l1_note: 中文“我没钱了”别说 I have no money 那么生硬，口语是 I ran out of money。

entries.head: watch out

senses.en: used to warn someone about danger

example.en: Watch out — the escalator is packed.

entries.l1_note: 提醒别人不是 be careful 才地道；watch out 更短更常用，后面接 for 再加对象。

entries.head: touch down

senses.en: when a plane lands

example.en: We touched down twenty minutes late.
example.zh: 我们晚点二十分钟落地。

entries.l1_note: 着陆是 touch down（两个词）；land 也对，但 touchdown 是名词。

entries.head: pull up

senses.en: when a vehicle stops at a place

example.en: The bus pulled up right as I got to the stop.

entries.l1_note: 停靠是 pull up；pull over 是靠边停，两者位置感不同。

entries.head: pull away

senses.en: when a vehicle starts moving away

example.en: I ran for it, but the train pulled away.
example.zh: 我冲过去，车还是开走了。

entries.l1_note: 开走是 pull away；pull out 是从车位驶出。

entries.head: speed up

senses.en: to go faster

example.en: Speed up a little — we're going to miss the exit.

entries.l1_note: 加速是 speed up；slow down 是减速，成对。

entries.head: stop over

senses.en: to stay somewhere briefly during a longer trip

example.en: We stopped over in Seoul for six hours.
example.zh: 我们在首尔中转停留了六小时。

entries.l1_note: 中途停留是 stop over；名词是 stopover。

entries.head: lay over

senses.en: to wait at an airport between flights

example.en: We laid over in Dubai for four hours.
example.zh: 我们在迪拜中转等了四小时。

entries.l1_note: lay over 多指航班中转；名词 layover。

entries.head: hop on

senses.en: to get on a vehicle quickly

example.en: Hop on the 43 bus — it goes straight there.

entries.l1_note: hop on 语气轻松，短途常用；正式场合用 get on。

entries.head: hop off

senses.en: to get off a vehicle quickly

example.en: Hop off at the next stop — the market is right there.
example.zh: 下一站下，市场就在那儿。

entries.l1_note: hop off 口语、短途；正式用 get off。

entries.head: pile in

senses.en: when several people get into a vehicle at once

example.en: Six of us piled in and drove to the airport.
example.zh: 我们六个人一窝蜂挤上车去机场。

entries.l1_note: 一群人挤进去是 pile in，不是 crowd into（也对但书面）。

entries.head: pile out

senses.en: when several people get out at once

example.en: Everyone piled out when the doors opened.

entries.l1_note: pile out 常出现在到站场景。

entries.head: crawl along

senses.en: when traffic moves very slowly

example.en: We crawled along for an hour on the ring road.
example.zh: 我们在环路上慢慢挪了一小时。

entries.l1_note: 车流慢行是 crawl along，不是 move slowly（太泛）。

entries.head: inch along

senses.en: to move forward very slowly

example.en: The line inched along toward the security gate.
example.zh: 队伍一点点挪向安检口。

entries.l1_note: 一寸寸挪是 inch along，比 crawl along 更慢。

entries.head: crash into

senses.en: when a vehicle hits something

example.en: He crashed into a pole while checking his phone.
example.zh: 他看手机时撞上了电线杆。

entries.l1_note: 撞上是 crash into，不是 hit on（撞到人用 hit）。
collocations: crash into the back of a car

entries.head: set down

senses.en: when a driver lets passengers get out

example.en: The driver set us down at the north gate.

entries.l1_note: set down 是让下车；set off 是出发。

entries.head: squeeze by

senses.en: to get past by pressing through a small space

example.en: Excuse me, can I squeeze by?
example.zh: 不好意思，能让我挤过去吗？

entries.l1_note: 挤过去是 squeeze by；挤出时间是 squeeze in。

entries.head: weave through

senses.en: to move in and out between things

example.en: The scooter wove through traffic like a video game.
example.zh: 电动车在车流里钻来钻去。

entries.l1_note: 穿梭是 weave through，不是 cross through（只是穿过）。

entries.head: merge into

senses.en: to join a road or flow of traffic

example.en: Merge into the left lane after the tunnel.

entries.l1_note: 汇入是 merge into；不是 join the road（不够准确）。

entries.head: switch over
entries.zh: 换到（另一条道、另一种交通）

senses.en: to change to another lane or method

example.en: Switch over to the express train at the next station.

entries.l1_note: 换车道/换乘是 switch over (to)；不是 change the line（中式）。

entries.head: change over

senses.en: to move from one train or bus to another

example.en: Change over at the central station and take Line 2.
example.zh: 在中央站换乘 2 号线。

entries.l1_note: 换乘是 change over / transfer；不是 change the train。

entries.head: ride out

senses.en: to get through a difficult period

example.en: We just rode out the traffic jam and missed the opening.
example.zh: 我们就这么熬过堵车，错过了开场。

entries.l1_note: ride out 是熬过去，不是骑出去。

entries.head: get by

senses.en: to manage to pass or survive

example.en: The truck can't get by — the street is too narrow.

entries.l1_note: get by 既指勉强通过，也指生活勉强维持。

entries.head: get out

senses.en: to leave a place

example.en: Get out before the doors close.

senses.en: to leave a vehicle

example.en: We got out at the wrong exit.

entries.l1_note: get out 是不及物；下车也可以说 get off the bus。get out of the car 才带宾语。
collocations: get out at the next stop

entries.head: jam into

senses.en: 塞进

example.en: We jammed into the last subway car.
example.zh: 我们挤进了最后一节地铁车厢。

entries.l1_note: jam into + 空间；不是“果酱”。

entries.head: run on

senses.en: 继续跑

example.en: The train ran on without stopping.

entries.l1_note: run on 是不及物“继续”；不是“运行在”。

entries.head: wave off

senses.en: 挥手送别

example.en: We waved off the bus from the platform.
example.zh: 我们在站台上挥手送别大巴。

entries.l1_note: wave off 是挥手送别/示意离开；不是“挥走”。

entries.head: zip around

senses.en: 快速穿梭

example.en: We zipped around the city on shared bikes.
example.zh: 我们骑共享单车在城市里快速穿梭。

entries.l1_note: zip around 是快速穿梭；口语。

example.en: I leave the house at 7:40 and still make the 8:00 subway.
example.zh: 我 7:40 出门，还能赶上 8 点的地铁。

example.en: I walk to the station when the weather is nice.
He drives to the office on rainy days.
example.zh: 下雨天他开车去办公室。

example.en: Leave before seven to avoid the rush hour.
The bus was late, but we still made it on time.
example.zh: 公交晚了，但我们还是准时到了。

example.zh: 我周五早点走去接孩子。

example.en: We waited for the bus for twenty minutes.
example.zh: 我们等公交等了二十分钟。

example.en: Run and you can still catch the bus.

Get on the bus at the front and pay there.
example.zh: 从前门上公交，在那儿付钱。

example.en: Get off the bus at the third stop.
I ran for the bus and made it just in time.
Ring the bell before your stop.
He gave up his seat to an old lady.
example.zh: 他给一位老太太让了座。

example.en: Move to the back; there's more room there.
You can pay the fare with your phone now.
example.zh: 现在可以用手机付车费。

example.en: I take the subway to work every day.
Buy a ticket at the machine before you go in.
Tap your card at the gate and wait for the green light.
We waited on the platform for the next train.
example.zh: 我们在站台等下一班车。

example.en: Read the map before you go down to the platform.
example.zh: 下到站台前先看地铁图。

Hold on tight; the train starts fast.
We pushed through the crowd to get off.
Follow the signs to find the exit.
Watch your step; the floor is wet.
The car won't start when it's this cold.
Fasten your seat belt before we go.
Turn the key and hold it for a second.
Step on the gas; the light is turning green.
Don't blow the horn at the crossing.
Turn left at the next intersection.
He went through a red light and got a ticket.
Wait for the light before you cross.
I'm stuck in traffic and will be ten minutes late.
example.zh: 我堵在路上了，晚十分钟到。

example.en: We sat in traffic for an hour on the way home.
example.zh: 回家路上我们堵了一小时。

example.en: A truck broke down and blocked the road.
example.zh: 一辆卡车抛锚，把路堵了。

example.en: Don't stop in the middle and hold up traffic.
Let's take another road to avoid the jam.
example.zh: 我们换条路走吧，避开堵车。

example.zh: 会开晚了，我错过了火车。

example.en: The bridge is closed for road work this week.
example.zh: 这座桥本周因修路封闭。

example.en: I missed the exit and had to turn around.
Leave the highway at Exit 12.
We need to get gas before the trip.
Fill up the tank before the long drive.
Pull into the station on the right.
The mechanic checked the oil and the tires.
example.zh: 师傅检查了机油和轮胎。

example.en: You can pay at the pump with a card.
Pay inside if the machine doesn't take your card.
example.zh: 机器不认你的卡就进店付。

example.en: I wash the car at the station on weekends.
We almost ran out of gas on the highway.
example.zh: 我们在高速上差点没油。

example.en: The car is low on gas; we should stop soon.
example.zh: 车快没油了，得找个加油站。

example.en: Get the receipt in case the company needs it.
example.zh: 拿好收据，公司报销要用。

example.en: It took twenty minutes to find a parking spot.
example.zh: 找了二十分钟才找到车位。

example.en: Park the car in the shade if you can.
example.zh: 能停阴凉处就停阴凉处。

example.en: I always back into a space in the garage.
example.zh: 我在车库总是倒车入库。

example.en: You have to pay for parking by the hour here.
We parked in a garage near the mall.
example.zh: 我们把车停在商场附近的车库。

entries.head: leave the car in the lot

example.en: Leave the car in the lot and walk to the office.
example.zh: 把车停在停车场，走去办公室。

example.en: You can't park on the street after ten.
He got a parking ticket for blocking the gate.
example.zh: 他堵了门口，吃了停车罚单。

example.en: Check the sign before you park; it's permit only.
example.zh: 停车前看标识，这里只给有证的车。

example.en: Lock the car and check the back seat.
